issue_context.title: Transfer to upload files from SFTP to Azure Blob Storage
issue_context.body:
**Description**

Transfer to scan files from sftp source path and upload them to Azure Blob Storage

**Use case / motivation**

* Scan a source path and upload files using a wildcard or the complete source path of a file at SFTP and upload these files to a Azure Blob Storage.

**PR Created**
 Process to upload sftp files to blob storage #9677

review_comments:
I think we want to have here a `replace` option.
What to do if a file is already present in the target? Overwrite it?
Similar to:
https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/8512e0507263495ddd326e27699c45cafd31a5e1/airflow/providers/amazon/aws/transfers/gcs_to_s3.py#L65-L72
Amazing! I am going to add this option.

I have added it as a parameter. But, it is possible to load it through WASB hook config json:
https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/azure-storage-blob/azure.storage.blob.blobclient?view=azure-python#upload-blob-data--blob-type--blobtype-blockblob---blockblob----length-none--metadata-none----kwargs-

It is the overwrite boolean option
